'''2007 Texas State Championship Allen Gaible LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dantooine Ops
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
